title.en: Build a nuclear plant like a ship? The first power would still be gas.
title.zh: 像造船一样建核电？最先发出的电仍来自燃气。

summary.en: Blue Energy proposes1,500-ton prefabricated blocks and staged gas-to-nuclear construction. A2030gas start and2032reactor additions are plans; lower costs are projections, not operating results.
summary.zh: Blue Energy以1500吨预制模块及燃气转核电分期建设破题；2030燃气起步、2032增核均为计划，降本非已运行结果。

title.en: 330,000 people equipped with Copilot. What counts as useful work?
title.zh: 33万人配上Copilot，AI的成效该怎么证明？

summary.en: Microsoft reports a330,000-plus employee rollout and26,000 active agents at Volkswagen. Access, monthly activity and measured productivity are three different numbers.
summary.zh: 微软称大众逾33万员工获配Copilot，过去一月逾2.6万agent活跃；获配、月活与实测生产率是三种不同指标。
